from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
import os

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/185-13/1_185-13_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/185-13_0_9c1ed527/1_185-13_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Initial Data"]

# Work only on the data area of the requested sheet.  The operation is to keep the
# first occurrence of each name within each block of rows, where a completely blank
# row separates blocks, and clear later duplicate name cells in that same block.
max_col = min(ws.max_column, 6)
max_row = ws.max_row

seen_names = set()
for r in range(1, max_row + 1):
    # Leave the header row intact.
    if r == 1:
        continue

    row_values = [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(1, max_col + 1)]
    is_blank_separator = all(v is None for v in row_values)

    if is_blank_separator:
        seen_names.clear()
        continue

    name_cell = ws.cell(r, 1)
    name = name_cell.value

    # Only nonblank names participate; rows with a blank name but shift data are not separators.
    if name is None:
        continue

    if name in seen_names:
        name_cell.value = None
    else:
        seen_names.add(name)

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Initial Data"]

def is_blank_value(value):
    return value is None or value == ""

# The data is in columns A:F.  Each completely blank row starts a new group.
# Within each group, keep only the first occurrence of each name in column A.
seen_names = set()

start_row = 2 if ws.cell(1, 1).value == "Name" else 1
for row in range(start_row, ws.max_row + 1):
    row_values = [ws.cell(row, col).value for col in range(1, 7)]

    if all(is_blank_value(value) for value in row_values):
        seen_names.clear()
        continue

    name_cell = ws.cell(row, 1)
    name = name_cell.value

    if is_blank_value(name):
        continue

    if name in seen_names:
        name_cell.value = None
    else:
        seen_names.add(name)

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
